name: Wingonia Ikpi
info:
Wingonia Ikpi is a visionary storyteller with a proven track record of excellence across the entertainment industry. A true cinephile who thrives on bold, nuanced narratives, she combines artistic ambition with exceptional production quality, setting a high standard in filmmaking.

As the CEO of Boxonia Blueprint– a production and talent management company, she continues to shape the future of African filmmaking through innovation, compelling storytelling and talent management. Boxonia Blueprint has gone on to co-produce Son of the Soil, a Global action thriller, and Nollybabes, one of the most creative and exciting films featuring fresh voices in the Nigerian film space.

Recently, Wingonia directed The Lost Days, a critically acclaimed movie that further cements her reputation as a formidable force. Her expertise spans ideation, production, direction, and strategic management, driving both commercial success and cultural impact. With a career that includes collaborations with major brands like Access Bank, Unilever, Urban Vision, Standard Chartered Bank, The FilmOne Limited, Action Xtreme and more, she has consistently elevated projects with her sharp creative instincts.

Furthermore, Wingonia has left an indelible mark on African entertainment, contributing to iconic TV series like Tinsel and Halita, as well as producing box office hits such as Ijakumo (Toyin Abraham) and Bank Alert (Okey Bakassi). Her work is showcased on leading global platforms, including Netflix, Prime Video, and Showmax, amplifying African stories to worldwide audiences.

In an industry that demands excellence and creativity as necessary qualities for participation— Wingonia Ikpi is here to stay.

name: Victoria Popoola
info:
Victoria Popoola is a finance professional with a solid background in data analytics, venture capital and debt financing, and, most recently, creative industry financing. She has invested in and supported early-stage start-ups across various industries in Africa and beyond. Her current focus is on the African creative space where she successfully built financing and investment products at scale for the region. To date, she has raised and managed over 700 million naira in film portfolios with a goal to standardize and overall increase commercial investment in the sector.

She has a long time passion for creative media, which drives support for creatives who are telling unique, positive African stories. She also believes that storytelling isn’t just entertainment. It’s a way to reshape narratives and celebrate African culture on a global scale. In her new role at Boxonia, she is keen to continue supporting African filmmakers and creators, and to amplify voices that matter.

name: Iredumare Opeyemi
info:
Iredumare Opeyemi, is a Managing Partner at Technolawgical Partners, brings extensive experience from roles at Transssion, Transsnet, and MTN Group. He’s overseen 2000 plus business partners and managed five hundred million dollars plus investments across 12 Middle Eastern and African markets for music business (2016–2023).

Notably, he resolved a two million dollars copyright infringement lawsuit and prioritized team collaboration and employee empowerment. Ire is the author of Music Commerce in Africa. He is dedicated to advancing human infrastructure in Africa’s creative industries, driven by passion for results and resilience in the face of challenges.

name: Rotipin Tobiloba
info:
Rotipin Tobiloba is a dynamic filmmaker and director influenced by visually compelling narratives / emotionally driven storytelling. With a passion for an exploration of human experiences, filled with emotion, vulnerability and truth.
He has consistently pushed the boundaries of storytelling, crafting films that resonate deeply with audiences.
Over the years, he has honed his craft through various projects, ranging from short films, documentaries, commercial work to experimental narratives.
Rotipin Tobiloba’s directorial style is influenced by the works of David Lynch, Ousmane Sembene and the French new wave, and I believe in creating stories that challenge the audience’s perspectives.

name: Lanre Felix
info:
Lanre Felix is a highly accomplished and versatile designer with extensive experience in brand development, social media design, and product design. He has led design teams and collaborated on various projects, elevating the visual identity and creative direction of numerous brands. Lanre’s keen eye for detail and deep understanding of branding principles have enabled him to create impactful designs that resonate with audiences and strengthen brand recognition.

In addition to his graphic design expertise, Lanre is an innovative product designer with a proven track record in delivering user-centric digital solutions. He has conceptualized, designed, and successfully launched several websites and mobile applications, merging aesthetics with functionality to enhance user experience and meet business goals.

Lanre's diverse skill set and adaptability to changing design trends have made him a key player in the design and product development industry. Whether leading a team or collaborating as a team member, he brings creativity, precision, and a results-driven approach to every project.
